title: shared OnceLock test cert means all test listeners accept same pinned cert
description: spawn_test_listener uses SHARED_TEST_CERT OnceLock so all test invocations share the same DER cert. PinnedCertVerifier pins to that cert. A misconfigured test connecting to the wrong loopback port would still pass TLS verification since all test servers share the same cert. Not a security issue in production but reduces test isolation.
